hero_subtitle: Non-competitive, easy-going dance classes for ages 5 to 95 in Columbia & Lexington, SC.
about_text: We offer non-competitive, friendly classes focused on building self-confidence, socialization, and developing coordination.
quote: “There is nothing impossible to him who will try.” — Alexander the Great

feature_cards.title: Tap Dance (Ages 5 to Adults)
feature_cards.text: Develop rhythm, coordination, and technique in a supportive, fun environment. Classes are tailored for all age groups from young beginners to adult tap enthusiasts.

feature_cards.title: Home of the Columbia Tappers
feature_cards.text: The Columbia Tappers offer everything from dancing grannies to Charleston flappers to OomPah polka dancers. Contact us for lively, fun entertainment for your event!

feature_cards.title: Clogging (Kids & Adults)
feature_cards.text: High-energy clogging classes great for socialization, fitness, and building confidence. Open to all skill levels with performance opportunities throughout the year.
